description: Land Acquisition - Panamura, Embilipitiya D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Amendments to the Notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1988/11 of 10.10.2016 by Thihagoda D/S Division, No. 1645/12 of 16.03.2010 by Wattala D/S Division and No. 1987/24 of 05.10.2016 by Mirigama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices describing specific land parcels to be acquired by the government, including detailed descriptions of the properties, their boundaries, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions, property descriptions, and land-related administrative procedures.
